actions.purpose: Answer a crew member, the owner, or staff from cited package and safety facts, including who can release a stop or hold
Route worker-data and deletion requests to compliance and customer requests for extra work to customer care
Check daily readiness of a package: credentials, weather window, assets, acknowledged version, materials
Draft a work package with hazards, controls, cited limits, hold points, stop conditions, and evidence slots
Propose an observed or suspected hidden condition or hazard from crew evidence, never a determination
Turn crew voice notes and photos into a daily report, incident, near-miss, hazard, field-change, or customer-request record for the worker to confirm
Propose arrived, not arrived (one resend under the same idempotency key), or duplicate for a crew item the office has not confirmed, from the office record read back under its key
Draft a safety_notice to an occupant or customer at risk from a site hazard, in their language; drafting it goes with an emergency page
Hold a released package that has not started because a required fact failed, and tell the crew lead and production
Alert the crew lead and site supervisor that a cited stop condition is present; the crew decides
Ask the crew for a missing safety or progress photo, a retake, or capture items handed over by the measurer
Put raised stops, release requests, lost controls, missing limits or plans, hazardous-material signs, and suspicious messages on a named person's path
Page the site supervisor at once for an injury, fall, downed line, fire, missed working-alone check-in, or anyone in danger
Propose issuing a package to its crew, offline copy included, once every gate and check passes
Propose releasing a hold once a newer cited fact fixes the failing one
Propose sending my own approved safety_notice draft; it always asks first
